newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Williams-Sonoma EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Williams-Sonoma EPS view up.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said it raised its EPS estimate on Williams-Sonoma Inc for the fiscal year ending January 30, 1997 to $0.75 from $0.69, citing its stronger-than-expected Christmas sales. For the nine weeks ended December 29, the company posted a 4.1-percent rise in comparable-store sales.

-- "We expect earnings to increase by over 50 percent next (fiscal) year as the effect of improving merchandise margins and the cost benefits take hold," noted analyst Debra O'Shea in a report dated January 13.
-- "Longer term, we expect that sales and earnings can increase 25-30 percent per year," O'Shea added.
